__comment: Pipeline Observability (TS-6, plans 14c) — 소스는 pipeline_run_metrics·pipeline_slo_observations 뿐. stage 처리량·quarantine 은 아직 flush 되는 메트릭이 없어 No data 가 정직한 상태다 — 가짜 수치 금지(honest-gap). uid 는 Watchtower 딥링크가 참조한다.
title: Orc Citadel · Pipeline

panels.title: Flush Freshness — 마지막 런 이후 경과(h)
panels.description: nightly flush(run_metrics)가 마지막으로 postgres 에 도달한 뒤 경과 시간. 24h 를 넘으면 nightly 가 죽었거나 flush 가 실패하고 있는 것.

targets.rawSql: SELECT round((extract(epoch FROM now() - max(recorded_at)) / 3600)::numeric, 1) AS "경과(h)" FROM pipeline_run_metrics

panels.title: SLO 관측 — slo05/06/07 ok 비율
panels.description: pipeline_slo_observations 누적. ok=true 비율이 떨어지면 해당 SLO 의 detail(jsonb)로 drill-down.

targets.rawSql: SELECT slo, kind, count(*) FILTER (WHERE ok) AS ok, count(*) AS total, round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE ok) / count(*), 1) AS "ok %" FROM pipeline_slo_observations GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2

panels.title: 소스별 최신 런 — saved · skipped · errors
panels.description: 가장 최근 run_id 의 소스 축(labels.source_id) 분해.

targets.rawSql: SELECT labels->>'source_id' AS source, max(value) FILTER (WHERE metric = 'saved') AS saved, max(value) FILTER (WHERE metric = 'skipped') AS skipped, max(value) FILTER (WHERE metric = 'errors') AS errors FROM pipeline_run_metrics WHERE labels ? 'source_id' AND run_id = (SELECT run_id FROM pipeline_run_metrics ORDER BY recorded_at DESC LIMIT 1) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: 수집 성공률 재료 — saved / skipped / errors 추이
panels.description: 런별 소스 합산. errors 가 saved 를 잠식하면 수집 성공률 하락 — 소스별 분해는 위 테이블.

targets.rawSql: SELECT recorded_at AS "time", metric, sum(value) AS value FROM pipeline_run_metrics WHERE metric IN ('saved', 'skipped', 'errors') AND $__timeFilter(recorded_at) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: 신규 문서 유입 — total_new 추이
panels.description: 런 스칼라(labels 없음). 0 이 이어지면 소스 고갈 또는 dedup 포화.

targets.rawSql: SELECT recorded_at AS "time", value AS total_new FROM pipeline_run_metrics WHERE metric = 'total_new' AND labels = '{}'::jsonb AND $__timeFilter(recorded_at) ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Stage 처리량 — extract · normalize · load (No data = 미계측)
panels.description: stage_* 메트릭은 아직 flush 되지 않는다(수집 단계만 영속). No data 는 정직한 표시 — stage 계측이 배선되면 자동으로 채워진다.

targets.rawSql: SELECT recorded_at AS "time", metric, sum(value) AS value FROM pipeline_run_metrics WHERE metric LIKE 'stage_%' AND $__timeFilter(recorded_at) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Quarantine 추이 (No data = 미계측)
panels.description: quarantined 메트릭은 아직 flush 되지 않는다. No data 는 정직한 표시 — L1 격리 계측이 배선되면 자동으로 채워진다.

targets.rawSql: SELECT recorded_at AS "time", sum(value) AS quarantined FROM pipeline_run_metrics WHERE metric = 'quarantined' AND $__timeFilter(recorded_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
